items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source: Custom scopes can be added via registerScope.
items.translation: 可以通过registerScope添加自定义作用域。

items.source:
Any exception that arises during destruction should be caught
and logged instead of propagated to the caller of this method.
items.translation: 任何在销毁过程中引发的异常都应被捕获并记录，而不是传播到此方法的调用者。

items.source: Return the Executor (possibly a TaskExecutor) for background bootstrapping, if any.
items.translation: 返回用于后台引导的Executor（可能是TaskExecutor），如果有。

items.source: Set the Executor (possibly a TaskExecutor) for background bootstrapping.
items.translation: 设置用于后台引导的Executor（可能是TaskExecutor）。

items.source: Determine whether an embedded value resolver has been registered with this bean factory, to be applied through resolveEmbeddedValue(String).
items.translation: 确定是否已在此 Bean 工厂中注册了嵌入式值解析器，以便通过 `resolveEmbeddedValue(String)` 应用。

items.source: Specify a ConversionService to use for converting property values, as an alternative to JavaBeans PropertyEditors.
items.translation: 指定一个用于转换属性值的ConversionService，作为 JavaBeans PropertyEditors 的替代方案。

items.source: This bean factory interface is not meant to be used in normal application code: Stick to BeanFactory or ListableBeanFactory for typical needs. This extended interface is just meant to allow for framework-internal plug'n'play and for special access to bean factory configuration methods.
items.translation: 该 Bean 工厂接口并非旨在用于常规应用程序代码：对于典型需求，请坚持使用 BeanFactory 或 ListableBeanFactory。此扩展接口仅用于支持框架内部的即插即用功能，以及提供对 Bean 工厂配置方法的特殊访问。

items.source: If the given registrar implements PropertyEditorRegistrar.overridesDefaultEditors() to return true, it will be applied lazily (only when default editors are actually needed).
items.translation: 如果给定的注册器实现了PropertyEditorRegistrar.overridesDefaultEditors()并返回true，它将被延迟应用（仅在确实需要默认编辑器时）。

items.source: Such a registrar creates new PropertyEditor instances and registers them on the given registry, fresh for each bean creation attempt. This avoids the need for synchronization on custom editors; hence, it is generally preferable to use this method instead of registerCustomEditor(Class, Class).
items.translation: 此类注册表会为每个 Bean 创建尝试创建新的 PropertyEditor 实例并将其注册到给定的注册表中，从而避免了对自定义编辑器的同步需求；因此，通常更推荐使用此方法而非 registerCustomEditor(Class, Class)。

items.source: Note that this method will register a shared custom editor instance; access to that instance will be synchronized for thread-safety. It is generally preferable to use addPropertyEditorRegistrar(PropertyEditorRegistrar) instead of this method, to avoid for the need for synchronization on custom editors.
items.translation: 请注意，此方法将注册一个共享的自定义编辑器实例；对该实例的访问将实现同步以确保线程安全。通常更推荐使用 addPropertyEditorRegistrar(PropertyEditorRegistrar) 而不是此方法，以避免对自定义编辑器进行同步的需求。

items.source: Note: Post-processors submitted here will be applied in the order of registration; any ordering semantics expressed through implementing the Ordered interface will be ignored. Note that autodetected post-processors (for example, as beans in an ApplicationContext) will always be applied after programmatically registered ones.
items.translation: 注意：在此处提交的后置处理器将按注册顺序应用；通过实现Ordered接口所表达的排序语义将被忽略。请注意，自动检测到的后置处理器（例如作为 ApplicationContext 中的 Bean）将始终在程序化注册的后置处理器之后应用。

items.source: A temporary ClassLoader is usually just specified if load-time weaving is involved, to make sure that actual bean classes are loaded as lazily as possible. The temporary loader is then removed once the BeanFactory completes its bootstrap phase.
items.translation: 如果涉及加载时织入，通常只需指定一个临时 ClassLoader，以确保实际 bean 类尽可能延迟加载。一旦 BeanFactory 完成引导阶段，该临时加载器即被移除。

items.source:
Note that the parent cannot be changed: It should only be set outside
a constructor if it isn't available at the time of factory instantiation.
items.translation: 注意父对象不可更改：它仅在工厂实例化时无法提供该对象的情况下，才应在构造函数之外设置。

items.source:
Note that this class loader will only apply to bean definitions
that do not carry a resolved bean class yet. This is the case as of
Spring 2.0 by default: Bean definitions only carry bean class names,
to be resolved once the factory processes the bean definition.
items.translation: 请注意，此类加载器仅适用于尚未携带已解析的 Bean 类的 Bean 定义。自 Spring 2.0 起默认情况即如此：Bean 定义仅携带 Bean 类名称，待工厂处理该 Bean 定义时再进行解析。

items.source:
Turn this flag off to enable hot-refreshing of bean definition objects
and in particular bean classes. If this flag is off, any creation of a bean
instance will re-query the bean class loader for newly resolved classes.
items.translation: 关闭此标志以启用 Bean 定义对象的刷新，特别是 Bean 类。如果关闭此标志，创建任何 Bean 实例时将重新查询 Bean 类加载器以获取新解析的类。

items.source:
There is no expression support active in a BeanFactory by default.
An ApplicationContext will typically set a standard expression strategy
here, supporting "#{...}" expressions in a Unified EL compatible style.
items.translation: BeanFactory 默认没有激活表达式支持。ApplicationContext 通常在此处设置标准的表达式策略，以兼容统一 EL 风格的 "#{...}" 表达式。

items.source:
This will override the default PropertyEditor mechanism and hence make
any custom editors or custom editor registrars irrelevant.
items.translation: 这将覆盖默认的 PropertyEditor 机制，从而使任何自定义编辑器或自定义编辑器注册器变得无关紧要。

items.source:
If the default PropertyEditor mechanism is active, the returned
TypeConverter will be aware of all custom editors that have been registered.
items.translation: 如果默认的 PropertyEditor 机制处于活动状态，则返回的 TypeConverter 将了解所有已注册的自定义编辑器。

items.source:
This will only return the names of explicitly registered scopes.
Built-in scopes such as "singleton" and "prototype" won't be exposed.
items.translation: 这将仅返回显式注册的 Scope 名称。像"singleton"和"prototype"这样的内置 Scope 将不会被暴露。

items.source:
This will only return explicitly registered scopes.
Built-in scopes such as "singleton" and "prototype" won't be exposed.
items.translation: 这将仅返回显式注册的 Scope。内置的 Scope，如 "singleton" 和 "prototype"，将不会被暴露。

items.source: This allows the application context to record metrics during application startup.
items.translation: 这允许应用程序上下文在应用启动期间记录指标。

items.source:
Should include all standard configuration settings as well as
BeanPostProcessors, Scopes, and factory-specific internal settings.
Should not include any metadata of actual bean definitions,
such as BeanDefinition objects and bean name aliases.
items.translation: 应包含所有标准配置设置，以及 BeanPostProcessor、作用域和工厂特定的内部设置。不应包含实际 bean 定义的元数据，例如 BeanDefinition 对象和 bean 名称别名。

items.source:
Typically invoked during factory configuration, but can also be
used for runtime registration of aliases. Therefore, a factory
implementation should synchronize alias access.
items.translation: 通常在工厂配置期间调用，但也可用于运行时注册别名。因此，工厂实现应同步对别名的访问。

items.source:
The value resolver may for example resolve placeholders
in target bean names and even in alias names.
items.translation: 值解析器例如可以解析目标 Bean 名称中的占位符，甚至别名名称中的占位符。

items.source: Return the ApplicationStartup for this bean factory.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 工厂的ApplicationStartup。

items.source: Return this factory's class loader for loading bean classes (only null if even the system ClassLoader isn't accessible).
items.translation: 返回此工厂的类加载器以加载 Bean 类（如果连系统 ClassLoader 都不可访问，则返回 `null`）。

items.source: Add a String resolver for embedded values such as annotation attributes.
items.translation: 添加一个用于嵌入值（如注解属性）的 String 解析器。

items.source:
Initialize the given PropertyEditorRegistry with the custom editors
that have been registered with this BeanFactory.
items.translation: 使用已注册到此 BeanFactory 的自定义编辑器初始化给定的 PropertyEditorRegistry。

items.source: Return the resolution strategy for expressions in bean definition values.
items.translation: 返回 Bean 定义值中表达式的解析策略。

items.source: Return the current number of registered BeanPostProcessors, if any.
items.translation: 返回当前已注册的 BeanPostProcessor 的数量（如果有的话）。

items.source: Return the associated ConversionService, if any.
items.translation: 返回关联的 ConversionService（如果有）。

items.source: Return the names of all beans that the specified bean depends on, if any.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 所依赖的所有 Bean 的名称（如果有）。

items.source: Return the names of all beans which depend on the specified bean, if any.
items.translation: 返回所有依赖于指定 Bean 的 Bean 的名称（如果有）。

items.source:
Return the temporary ClassLoader to use for type matching purposes,
if any.
items.translation: 返回用于类型匹配目的的临时 ClassLoader（如果有）。

items.source:
Return whether to cache bean metadata such as given bean definitions
(in merged fashion) and resolved bean classes.
items.translation: 返回是否缓存 Bean 元数据（如以合并方式给出的 Bean 定义和解析后的 Bean 类）。

items.source: Determine whether the specified bean is currently in creation.
items.translation: 确定指定的 Bean 当前是否处于创建中。

items.source: Determine whether the bean with the given name is a FactoryBean.
items.translation: 确定给定名称的 Bean 是否为 FactoryBean。

items.source:
Register a dependent bean for the given bean,
to be destroyed before the given bean is destroyed.
items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 注册一个依赖的 Bean，以便在给定 Bean 销毁之前进行销毁。

items.source: Register the given scope, backed by the given Scope implementation.
items.translation: 注册给定的作用域，该作用域由给定的 Scope 实现支持。

items.source: Resolve the given embedded value, for example, an annotation attribute.
items.translation: 解析给定的嵌入值，例如注解属性。

items.source:
Return a merged BeanDefinition for the given bean name,
merging a child bean definition with its parent if necessary.
Considers bean definitions in ancestor factories as well.
items.translation: 返回给定 bean 名称的合并 BeanDefinition，如有必要则合并子 BeanDefinition 与其父 BeanDefinition。同时考虑祖先工厂中的 BeanDefinition。

items.source:
Explicitly control the current in-creation status of the specified bean.
For container-internal use only.
items.translation: 显式控制指定 Bean 的当前创建状态。仅供容器内部使用。

items.source: propertyEditorClass - the PropertyEditor class to register
items.translation: propertyEditorClass - 要注册的 PropertyEditor 类。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if this factory is already associated with a parent BeanFactory
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果此工厂已经与父 BeanFactory 关联

items.source: beanClassLoader - the class loader to use, or null to suggest the default class loader
items.translation: beanClassLoader - 要使用的类加载器，或为 null 以建议默认类加载器

items.source: BeanDefinitionStoreException - if the alias is already in use
items.translation: BeanDefinitionStoreException - 如果别名已被使用

items.source: parentBeanFactory - the parent BeanFactory
items.translation: parentBeanFactory - 父 BeanFactory

items.source: registrar - the PropertyEditorRegistrar to register
items.translation: registrar - 要注册的 PropertyEditorRegistrar

items.source: registry - the PropertyEditorRegistry to initialize
items.translation: registry - 用于初始化的 PropertyEditorRegistry

items.source: valueResolver - the String resolver to apply to embedded values
items.translation: valueResolver - 用于解析嵌入值的字符串解析器

items.source: value - the value to resolve
items.translation: value - 要解析的值

items.source: beanPostProcessor - the post-processor to register
items.translation: beanPostProcessor - 要注册的处理器

items.source: scopeName - the scope identifier
items.translation: scopeName - 作用域标识符

items.source: scope - the backing Scope implementation
items.translation: scope - 底层 Scope 实现

items.source: scopeName - the name of the scope
items.translation: scopeName - 作用域的名称

items.source: the registered Scope implementation, or null if none
items.translation: 已注册的 Scope 实现，或者如果没有则返回null。

items.source: applicationStartup - the new application startup
items.translation: applicationStartup - 新的应用程序启动

items.source: otherFactory - the other BeanFactory to copy from
items.translation: otherFactory - 要复制的另一个 BeanFactory

items.source: beanName - the canonical name of the target bean
items.translation: beanName - 目标 Bean 的正则名称

items.source: alias - the alias to be registered for the bean
items.translation: alias - 要为该 Bean 注册的别名

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean to retrieve the merged definition for
items.translation: beanName - 要检索合并定义的名称的 Bean

items.source: name - the name of the bean to check
items.translation: name - 要检查的 Bean 的名称

items.source: whether the bean is a FactoryBean (false means the bean exists but is not a FactoryBean)
items.translation: bean 是否为 FactoryBean （false 表示 bean 存在但不是 FactoryBean）

items.source: inCreation - whether the bean is currently in creation
items.translation: inCreation - 指示该 Bean 当前是否处于创建中

items.source: dependentBeanName - the name of the dependent bean
items.translation: dependentBeanName - 依赖 Bean 的名称

items.source: beanInstance - the bean instance to destroy
items.translation: beanInstance - 要销毁的 Bean 实例

items.source: beanName - the name of the scoped bean
items.translation: beanName - 作用域 Bean 的名称

items.source: the resolved value (may be the original value as-is)
items.translation: 解析后的值（可能是原始值本身）

items.source: the array of scope names, or an empty array if none
items.translation: 作用域名称数组，如果没有则为空数组。

items.source: a (potentially merged) BeanDefinition for the given bean
items.translation: 给定 bean 的（可能已合并）BeanDefinition

items.source: whether the bean is currently in creation
items.translation: bean 当前是否处于创建中

items.source: the array of dependent bean names, or an empty array if none
items.translation: 依赖的 Bean 名称数组，如果没有则为空数组。

items.source:
the array of names of beans which the bean depends on,
or an empty array if none
items.translation: bean 所依赖的 Bean 名称数组，若无依赖则为空数组。

items.source: Set the ApplicationStartup for this bean factory.
items.translation: 为此 Bean 工厂设置ApplicationStartup。

items.source: Scope identifier for the standard prototype scope: "prototype".
items.translation: 标准原型作用域的标识符："prototype"。

items.source: Scope identifier for the standard singleton scope: "singleton".
items.translation: 标准单例作用域的 Scope 标识符："singleton"。

items.source:
Add a new BeanPostProcessor that will get applied to beans created
by this factory.
items.translation: 添加一个新的 BeanPostProcessor，该处理器将应用于此工厂创建的 Bean。

items.source: Add a PropertyEditorRegistrar to be applied to all bean creation processes.
items.translation: 添加一个 PropertyEditorRegistrar 以应用于所有 Bean 创建过程。

items.source: Copy all relevant configuration from the given other factory.
items.translation: 从给定的其他工厂复制所有相关配置。

items.source:
Destroy the given bean instance (usually a prototype instance
obtained from this factory) according to its bean definition.
items.translation: 根据该 Bean 定义销毁给定的 Bean 实例（通常是从本工厂获取的原型实例）。

items.source: Destroy the specified scoped bean in the current target scope, if any.
items.translation: 销毁当前目标作用域中指定的作用域 Bean（如果存在）。

items.source:
Destroy all singleton beans in this factory, including inner beans that have
been registered as disposable.
items.translation: 销毁此工厂中的所有单例 Bean，包括已注册为可丢弃的内部 Bean。

items.source:
Return a merged BeanDefinition for the given bean name,
merging a child bean definition with its parent if necessary.
items.translation: 返回给定 bean 名称的合并 BeanDefinition，如有必要则合并子 BeanDefinition 与其父 BeanDefinition。

items.source: Return the Scope implementation for the given scope name, if any.
items.translation: 返回给定作用域名称的作用域实现（如果有的话）。

items.source: Return the names of all currently registered scopes.
items.translation: 返回所有当前已注册的 Scope 的名称。

items.source: Obtain a type converter as used by this BeanFactory.
items.translation: 获取此 BeanFactory 使用的类型转换器。

items.source: Given a bean name, create an alias.
items.translation: 给定一个 Bean 名称，创建一个别名。

items.source:
Register the given custom property editor for all properties of the
given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型的所有属性注册给定的自定义属性编辑器。

items.source:
Resolve all alias target names and aliases registered in this
factory, applying the given StringValueResolver to them.
items.translation: 解析此工厂中注册的所有别名目标名称和别名，并将给定的 StringValueResolver 应用于它们。

items.source: Set the class loader to use for loading bean classes.
items.translation: 设置用于加载 Bean 类的类加载器。

items.source: Specify the resolution strategy for expressions in bean definition values.
items.translation: 指定 Bean 定义值中表达式的解析策略。

items.source:
Set whether to cache bean metadata such as given bean definitions
(in merged fashion) and resolved bean classes.
items.translation: 设置是否缓存 Bean 元数据（如给定的 Bean 定义（以合并方式）和解析后的 Bean 类）。

items.source: Explicitly control the current in-creation status of the specified bean.
items.translation: 显式控制指定 Bean 的当前创建状态。

items.source: Set the parent of this bean factory.
items.translation: 设置此 BeanFactory 的父级。

items.source: Specify a temporary ClassLoader to use for type matching purposes.
items.translation: 指定用于类型匹配的临时 ClassLoader。

items.source:
Set a custom type converter that this BeanFactory should use for converting
bean property values, constructor argument values, etc.
items.translation: 为 BeanFactory 设置一个自定义类型转换器，用于转换 bean 属性值、构造函数参数值等。

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean definition with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean 定义

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean

items.source: requiredType - type of the property
items.translation: requiredType - 属性的类型

items.source: valueResolver - the StringValueResolver to apply
items.translation: valueResolver - 要应用的 StringValueResolver

items.translation: beanName - Bean 定义的名称
